quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.

habits.title: Move: 20-minute walk
habits.detail: When I finish breakfast, I will put on shoes and walk outside for 20 minutes, before opening the laptop.

habits.title: SelfControl block
habits.detail: When I come back from the walk, I will start SelfControl (x.com, youtube.com, linkedin.com) before reading anything.

habits.title: LinkedIn post
habits.detail: When the coach shows today's draft, I will tweak it and publish it before starting the SelfControl block. Next up: Comunidad Antesis.

habits.title: List one item for sale
habits.detail: When I close the laptop, I will photograph one thing I don't use and send the photos to the coach. Ledger: ventas.chiq.me

goals.title: Consulate: get a new appointment date
goals.detail: Open the consulate booking page or email them; mention the 11-11 appointment was missed because the highway was closed. Envelope is ready; when it's booked, add it to Reminders.

goals.title: Comunidad Antesis LinkedIn post: write 3 sentences
goals.detail: Carried since 11-05, so shrink it: what it is (sells to buyers in several countries), one hard thing you built (multi-country pricing), one screenshot. Ask the coach to polish it.

goals.title: Remove the CodeRabbit line from the resume
goals.detail: Find where Resume(v12-fixed).pdf was made (online builder or Drive source), delete the line, re-export. Until then send cv/main_example.pdf from ~/c/ai-job-search.
